failureThreshold.title: failureThreshold
failureThreshold.description:
Number of consecutive failures for the probe to be considered failed after having succeeded.
Defaults to 0 (immediately fail on first failure).

Number of consecutive failures for the probe to be considered failed after having succeeded.
Defaults to 0 (immediately fail on first failure).

url.title: url
url.description:
HTTP or HTTPS URL to probe. The probe succeeds if the server responds with a 2xx or 3xx status code.
Probe does not follow redirects.

HTTP or HTTPS URL to probe. The probe succeeds if the server responds with a 2xx or 3xx status code.

timeout.description:
